fine_art_intro_1: Zojambula zapamwamba zakhala chikayikidwe cha anthu olemera kwa zaka mazana ndipo nthawi zambiri zimaonedwa ngati malo osungira chuma.
fine_art_intro_2: Bitcoin ndi ndalama zadigitala zomwe anthu ambiriso amaona ngati malo osungira chuma ndi chikayikidwe.
fine_art_intro_3: Koma kodi zojambula zamaonekedwe zimasiyana bwanji ndi ndalama zadigitala ngati Bitcoin? Tiyeni tione kusiyana pakati pa Bitcoin ndi Zojambula Zapamwamba.
point_1_summary_1: Bitcoin iliyonse imafanana ndipo ingasinthidwe. Chojambula chilichonse ndi chapadera — kupangidwa kosiyana, mbiri, mkhalidwe, ndi chiyambi zimapangitsa kuyerekeza kwachindunji kukhala kovuta kwambiri.
point_2_summary_1: Bitcoin imagulitsidwa 24/7 pa msika wa padziko lonse womwe ungafikidwe ndi aliyense. Zojambula zapamwamba zimafunika nyumba zapadera za auction, ogulitsa achinsinsi, kapena ma gallery ndipo zikhoza kutenga miyezi kuti zigulitsidwe.
point_3_summary_1: Kugula kapena kugulitsa Bitcoin kumawononga ndalama zochepera 1%, nthawi zambiri zochepa kwambiri. Kugulitsa kojambula kumawonjezera 30–40% mu premium ya wogula, ndalama, inshuwalansi, kunyamula, ndi ndalama zotsimikiziridwa.
point_4_summary_1: Bitcoin imagawanika m'magawo 100 miliyoni a satoshi, yokwanira kugwiritsa ntchito kulikonse. Simungakhale ndi kachigawo ka chithunzi kapena ngodya ya chosema popanda ngozi ya munthu wina.
point_5_summary_1: Kukhala ndi Bitcoin ndi kutsimikizika kwake kungathe kutsimikiziridwa mwa cryptographic ndi aliyense pa blockchain. Kutsimikizika kwa zojambula ndi kokwera mtengo, kochedwa, ndipo amatchedwa kwambiri ndi opanga zabodza — kuwononga mtengo wa zojambula mwadzidzidzi.
point_6_summary_1: Bitcoin yokweza moyenera ikhoza kupulumuka pa madzi osefukira, moto, chivomerezi, ndi kuba. Zojambula zapamwamba zili zovuta ku mtundu uliwonse wa kuwonongeka kwa thupi, ndipo inshuwalansi sikukwanira pa zonse.
point_7_summary_1: Aliyense amene ali ndi internet ndi ndalama zochepa akhoza kugula Bitcoin. Kugula zojambula zapamwamba kuli kochepa kwa osonkhanitsa olemera okha okhala ndi mwayi wa auction ndi luso lapadera.
